comments.body:
Are you thinking 4 packages in a single module? along the lines of:

org.fcrepo.importexport.import
org.fcrepo.importexport.export
org.fcrepo.importexport.common
org.fcrepo.importexport.driver
I'll work this after the major development tasks for this sprint are merged.
"import" is a reserved word, so I'll call the package "org.fcrepo.importexport.importer" and "org.fcrepo.importexport.exporter"

I've refactored the classes but now I've got several dependency problems. Some of the integration test dependencies (from all those fedora jars) conflict with some of our other test dependencies (jsonld, etc.).

@awoods is it acceptable to have two modules, one with all our code and another with our integration tests?

Michael Durbin, no problem. Collapsing down to two modules seems reasonable: functional and integration tests.
Go for it.
Pending response to code review comments; Namely, collapsing into a single module and using Cargo.
This looks great... pending response to final/minor code review comments.
